_about: Fixture company records for scripts/mineiq-grounding-eval.mjs. Fictional companies; every figure is invented for the test and appears nowhere else. `search` rows have the shape mineiq_search() returns (0050a); rows with superseded_by set are what the SQL filters out (f.superseded_by is null) and are kept here so the harness can prove the API path never surfaces them.
